# Marduk: the stories first, then the spelling

Before the spelling, the story. **Marduk** earns its restoration the old way — through what was actually told.

## The Stories That Carry the Name

**Marduk Slays Tiamat and Builds the World.** In the Babylonian Enuma Elish ('When on High'), the younger gods disturb the primordial Apsu and Tiamat.  After Apsu is killed, Tiamat raises an army of monsters to avenge him.  Marduk alone accepts the challenge, on condition that the gods grant him supreme kingship.

**Marduk Receives His Names.** The seventh and final tablet of the Enuma Elish lists Marduk's fifty names, each explained as a function or title he has absorbed from older gods.  Anu, Enlil, and Ea yield aspects of their sovereignty to him; his names declare him creator, provider, judge, and shepherd.  This is not mere praise but theological consolidation: by naming, the older pantheon legally transfers cosmic authority to Babylon's patron deity.

**Marduk and the Gift of Kingship.** The prologue to the Code of Hammurabi names Marduk as the god who called Hammurabi 'to bring about the welfare of the people' and 'to cause justice to prevail in the land. ' Kingship is thus a delegated office: the king rules because Marduk has chosen him, and his laws are legitimate because they extend Marduk's own ordering power.  Nebuchadnezzar II later boasted of rebuilding Esagila and Etemenanki, framing his reign as an act of cultic service to Marduk.

## The Name Travels

Marduk absorbed functions from Enlil (kingship and the decree of destinies), Ea/Enki (wisdom and water), and Šamaš (justice and solar radiance).  His rise parallels the political rise of Babylon: when Babylon was small, he was a local storm-god; when Babylon became an imperial capital, he became king of the gods.

## The Address It Earned

The temple of **Marduk** stands at [/marduk/](/marduk/) — [lore](/marduk/lore/), [scholars](/marduk/scholars/), [patterns](/marduk/patterns/) — because a name carrying this much story deserves more than a parking page. One decisive feature survives — a single, honest mark — which places the restoration in Tier-2: exact, and exactly labeled.
